label: no_progress
description: The 47k$-style slow burn: an analyzer and a verifier debate endlessly. Every turn carries genuinely different text and a different cost, so repetition detectors never fire -- yet no file is ever edited and no test ever runs. Activity is high, cost climbs, real progress stays at zero.

args.thought: the latency spike likely comes from the retry backoff being too aggressive

args.critique: backoff is fine; consider connection pool exhaustion instead

args.thought: pool exhaustion is plausible, but metrics show idle connections, so maybe DNS

args.critique: DNS resolves in 2ms per traces; look at TLS handshake renegotiation

args.thought: TLS renegotiation could explain the tail; or it is head-of-line blocking on h2

args.critique: h2 multiplexing should absorb that; revisit the retry backoff hypothesis

args.thought: circling back, the backoff jitter window might be miscomputed under load

args.critique: jitter looks correct in code review; could be the load balancer draining nodes

args.thought: LB draining is interesting -- though that would show as 503s, which we do not see

args.critique: no 503s indeed; perhaps a slow downstream cache fill on cold keys

args.thought: cold cache fill matches the morning pattern; or it loops back to pool exhaustion

args.critique: we already ruled out pool exhaustion; let me reconsider the TLS angle once more
